summary: Exact-text-pin test (test_babysit_merge_files_deferred_issues_before_the_merge_queue_steps) verifies the re-read-suggestions-and-comments instruction is present verbatim and precedes the unmodified base merge-queue instructions across all 3 built-in workflows; confirmed via monkeypatch counterexamples that dropping the re-read step, dropping the user-comments clause, or reordering it after the merge steps all break the assertion.
